docstring:
Strip surrounding whitespace and collapse whitespace runs to single spaces.

Args:
    text: Text whose whitespace is to be normalized.

Returns:
    The text with surrounding whitespace removed and internal whitespace replaced by single spaces.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield stripped, nonblank lines from text.

Args:
    text: Text to split into lines.

Yields:
    Each line with leading and trailing whitespace removed, excluding empty results.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield words and their start and end indices in the text.

Words contain Unicode word characters except underscores, with optional internal straight or curly apostrophes between runs of those characters.

Args:
    text: Text to scan for words.

Yields:
    Tuples of the matched word, inclusive start index, and exclusive end index.
label: correct

docstring:
Split a search query into tokens, respecting quotes and escapes.

Remove matching quote delimiters and treat backslashes as escapes except inside single quotes. Preserve empty quoted tokens.

Args:
    query: Search query to split on whitespace outside quotes.
    fold_case: Whether to casefold each token; defaults to False.

Returns:
    A list of tokens in query order, optionally casefolded.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the query ends with an unfinished escape or has an unclosed quote.
label: correct

docstring:
Return uppercase initials from alphabetic runs in a name.

Digits, underscores, and non-word characters separate runs rather than contribute initials.

Args:
    name: Name whose alphabetic runs provide the initials.

Returns:
    The uppercase first character of each alphabetic run, joined into a string.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a lowercase ASCII slug, shortened to the maximum length.

Apply NFKD normalization, discard non-ASCII characters, and join alphanumeric runs with the separator. Shortening preserves complete words when possible but truncates the first word if necessary.

Args:
    text: Text to normalize and convert into a slug.
    separator: Word separator, either '-' or '_'; defaults to '-'.
    max_length: Positive maximum slug length; defaults to 80.

Returns:
    The slug, at most max_length characters long, possibly empty.

Raises:
    ValueError: If separator is neither '-' nor '_'.
    ValueError: If max_length is less than 1.
label: correct

docstring:
Parse delimiter-separated key-value properties into a dictionary.

Ignore empty segments and strip surrounding whitespace from keys and values. Split each nonempty segment at its first equals sign; values may be empty.

Args:
    text: Text containing key-value properties separated by the delimiter.
    delimiter: Nonempty property separator; defaults to a semicolon.

Returns:
    A dictionary mapping property keys to stripped string values.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the delimiter is empty, a nonempty segment lacks '=', or keys are empty or duplicated.
label: correct

docstring:
Render named placeholders and escaped braces in a template.

Placeholders use names matching [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; doubled braces become literal braces. Values are converted to strings, with None rendered as an empty string.

Args:
    template: Template text containing named placeholders and optionally doubled braces.
    values: Mapping of placeholder names to replacement values.
    strict: Whether to reject missing values and invalid braces; defaults to True.

Returns:
    The rendered string, preserving missing placeholders and invalid braces when strict is False.

Raises:
    KeyError: If strict is True and a placeholder name is absent from values.
    ValueError: If strict is True and an unmatched or invalid brace is encountered.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield stripped setting names and values from nonblank, noncomment lines.

Split each setting at the first separator occurrence; values may be empty. Validation occurs during iteration.

Args:
    text: Text containing one setting per line.
    separator: Nonempty separator between setting names and values; defaults to '='.
    comment_prefix: Prefix marking stripped comment lines; defaults to '#'; empty disables comment skipping.

Yields:
    A tuple of stripped setting name and value for each setting line.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the separator is empty, a setting line lacks it, or a setting name is empty.
label: correct

docstring:
Normalize text with NFKC and collapse whitespace to single spaces.

Yield control once before normalization; strip leading and trailing whitespace.

Args:
    text: Text to normalize and consolidate whitespace in.

Returns:
    The NFKC-normalized string with whitespace-separated words joined by single spaces.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield text and field tokens from a template string.

Collapse $$ to a literal dollar sign and recognize ${name} fields containing dot-separated ASCII identifiers. In non-strict mode, preserve invalid or unclosed fields as literal text.

Args:
    template: Template string to tokenize.
    strict: Whether to reject invalid or unclosed fields; defaults to True.

Yields:
    Pairs of ('text', literal text) or ('field', field name), omitting empty text tokens.

Raises:
    ValueError: If strict is True and a field is unclosed or has an invalid name.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield starting indices of matching substrings in text.

Whole-word matches require adjacent characters, when present, to be neither alphanumeric nor underscores. Accepted matches advance by the needle length unless overlap is enabled; rejected matches advance by one character.

Args:
    text: Text to search.
    needle: Nonempty substring to find.
    overlap: Allow overlapping matches; defaults to False.
    whole_word: Require whole-word boundaries; defaults to False.

Yields:
    Zero-based starting indices of accepted matches, in ascending order.

Raises:
    ValueError: If needle is empty.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a lowercase ASCII slug from a title.

Apply NFKD normalization, discard non-ASCII characters, and join runs of ASCII letters and digits.

Args:
    title: Text to normalize into a slug.
    separator: Hyphen or underscore joining matched runs; defaults to a hyphen.

Returns:
    The joined lowercase ASCII runs, or an empty string if none match.

Raises:
    ValueError: If separator is neither a hyphen nor an underscore.
label: correct

docstring:
Return contextual excerpts for case-insensitive literal query matches.

Matches are non-overlapping; excerpts include ellipses where surrounding text is omitted. An empty query or zero maximum hits returns an empty list.

Args:
    text: Text to search.
    query: Literal substring to match case-insensitively.
    context: Maximum characters included before and after each match; defaults to 25.
    max_hits: Maximum number of matches returned; defaults to 10.

Returns:
    A list of (match start index, excerpt) tuples in text order, limited to max_hits.

Raises:
    ValueError: If context is negative.
    ValueError: If max_hits is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the discounted price rounded to two decimal places.

Args:
    price: Finite, nonnegative original price.
    discount_percent: Finite discount percentage between zero and 100, inclusive.

Returns:
    The price after applying the percentage discount, rounded to two decimal places.

Raises:
    ValueError: If price is nonfinite or negative, or discount_percent is nonfinite or outside [0, 100].
label: correct

docstring:
Return fractional returns between consecutive prices.

Args:
    prices: Finite, strictly positive prices in sequence order.

Returns:
    A list of current / previous - 1 for consecutive prices; empty for fewer than two prices.

Raises:
    ValueError: If any price is nonfinite or not strictly positive.
label: correct

docstring:
Parse shell-style assignment text into a dictionary.

Split tokens using POSIX shell quoting without treating comments specially, then split each token at its first equals sign. Validate keys against [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]* before optional lowercasing; detect duplicates afterward.

Args:
    text: Shell-style quoted, whitespace-separated key=value assignments.
    duplicate_policy: Duplicate handling: "error" raises (default), "first" keeps the first, "last" keeps the last.
    lowercase_keys: Whether to lowercase validated keys before duplicate detection; defaults to False.
    allow_empty_values: Whether to permit empty values; defaults to True.

Returns:
    A dictionary mapping parsed, optionally lowercased keys to string values.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the duplicate policy is invalid, quoting is invalid, an equals sign is missing, a key is invalid, an empty value is disallowed, or a duplicate occurs under "error" policy.
label: correct

docstring:
Replace template placeholders with asynchronously fetched text.

Fetch each distinct key sequentially, applying the timeout to each fetch separately. Substitute only original placeholders matching {{ key }}, where keys start with an ASCII letter or underscore and contain ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or dots.

Args:
    template: Template text containing placeholders to replace.
    client: Client whose asynchronous fetch_text(key) method supplies replacement strings.
    timeout: Finite, positive timeout in seconds per fetch; defaults to 5.0.
    missing_value: Replacement for keys raising KeyError; None raises KeyError instead.

Returns:
    The template with matched placeholders replaced, or unchanged if none match.

Raises:
    ValueError: If timeout is nonfinite or nonpositive.
    KeyError: If fetching a key raises KeyError and missing_value is None.
    TimeoutError: If a fetch times out or raises TimeoutError.
    TypeError: If a fetched value or missing-value replacement is not a string.
label: correct

docstring:
Calculate the monthly loan payment including a financed fee.

Add the financed fee to the principal before calculating payments. Return the balance divided by months when the annual rate or computed denominator is zero.

Args:
    principal: Finite, nonnegative loan principal.
    annual_rate: Finite, nonnegative annual interest rate, divided by 12 to obtain the monthly rate.
    months: Positive integer loan term in months; booleans are rejected.
    financed_fee: Finite, nonnegative fee added to principal; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    The monthly payment calculated from the financed balance, interest rate, and loan term.

Raises:
    ValueError: If any monetary input or rate is nonfinite or negative, months is nonpositive, or the financed balance is nonfinite.
    TypeError: If months is a boolean or not an integer.
label: correct

docstring:
Parse delimited text into rows of string fields.

Empty rows are rows with no fields, not rows containing only empty or whitespace fields. Parsing uses strict CSV rules.

Args:
    text: Delimited text to parse.
    delimiter: Single-character field separator excluding carriage return, newline, and double quote; defaults to comma.
    strip_fields: Whether to strip surrounding whitespace from each parsed field; defaults to True.
    skip_empty_rows: Whether to omit rows with no fields; defaults to True.

Returns:
    A list of rows, each containing parsed string fields.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the delimiter is invalid or strict CSV parsing raises csv.Error.
label: correct

docstring:
Calculate invoice totals with discounts, tax, and cent rounding.

Round each line amount, the subtotal, discount, and tax to cents using ROUND_HALF_UP. Apply tax to the subtotal minus the rounded discount.

Args:
    items: List of (unit price, quantity) pairs with finite nonnegative prices and nonnegative integer, non-boolean quantities.
    tax_rate: Finite nonnegative tax rate; defaults to zero.
    discount_rate: Finite discount rate between zero and one inclusive; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    A dictionary mapping subtotal, discount, tax, and total to Decimal amounts.

Raises:
    ValueError: If rates or prices are nonfinite, rates violate their bounds, or prices or quantities are negative.
    TypeError: If any quantity is a boolean or not an integer.
label: correct

docstring:
Fetch and return a symbol's finite, positive last trade price.

Args:
    client: Client whose asynchronous get_quote method retrieves the quote.
    symbol: Ticker symbol, stripped of surrounding whitespace and uppercased before requesting the quote.

Returns:
    The quote's last_price converted to a finite, positive float.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the stripped symbol is empty or the converted price is nonfinite or nonpositive.
label: correct

docstring:
Fetch an invoice and return its outstanding balance rounded to cents.

Missing discount, tax, and amount paid default to zero; tax is validated even when excluded. Overpayments produce a zero balance, and rounding uses ROUND_HALF_UP.

Args:
    client: Client whose asynchronous get_invoice method retrieves the invoice.
    invoice_id: Identifier of the invoice to retrieve.
    include_tax: Whether to add tax to the discounted subtotal; defaults to True.

Returns:
    The nonnegative outstanding balance as a Decimal rounded to two decimal places.

Raises:
    ValueError: If any invoice amount is nonfinite or negative, or the discount exceeds the subtotal.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the balance after applying the period interest rate.

Yield control to the event loop before calculating the updated balance.

Args:
    balance: Finite, nonnegative balance to apply interest to.
    period_rate: Finite interest rate for the period, at least -1.

Returns:
    The balance multiplied by one plus the period rate.

Raises:
    ValueError: If balance is nonfinite or negative, or period_rate is nonfinite or below -1.
label: correct

docstring:
Calculate the portfolio return using normalized holding weights.

Fetch holding returns concurrently, including returns for zero-weight holdings, and normalize weights by their total.

Args:
    client: Client providing awaitable get_period_return(symbol, days) calls.
    weights: Mapping of holding symbols to finite, nonnegative weights with a positive total.
    days: Positive holding period in days; defaults to 30.

Returns:
    The sum of holding returns multiplied by their normalized weights, as a float.

Raises:
    ValueError: If days is nonpositive, holdings are empty, weights are nonfinite or negative, or their total is nonpositive.
    ValueError: If any converted holding return is nonfinite or less than -1.
label: correct

docstring:
Convert an amount using bid/ask quotes and apply a fee.

Currency codes are stripped and uppercased; matching source and target return the amount without fees. Conversion prefers a direct or reverse quote over a two-leg bridge route, multiplying by bids or dividing by reverse asks, then applies the fee once.

Args:
    amount: Finite, nonnegative amount in the source currency.
    quotes: Mapping of currency-code pairs to bid and ask tuples.
    source: Source currency code.
    target: Target currency code.
    bridge: Intermediate currency when no direct or reverse quote exists; defaults to USD.
    fee_rate: Finite fee fraction from zero inclusive to one exclusive; defaults to no fee.

Returns:
    The converted amount after fees, or the original amount when normalized currency codes match.

Raises:
    ValueError: If amount or fee rate is invalid, normalized codes are empty, used quotes are invalid, or conversion becomes nonfinite.
    KeyError: If a required conversion leg has neither a direct nor a reverse quote.
label: correct

docstring:
Calculate trades and remaining cash for a target portfolio allocation.

Target weights are normalized after their sum is checked within 1e-9 of one; holdings absent from the targets are fully sold. Unless fractional shares are enabled, desired holdings are rounded down to whole shares.

Args:
    holdings: Current share counts by symbol, each finite and nonnegative.
    prices: Finite, positive prices for every held or targeted symbol.
    target_weights: Nonempty mapping of finite, nonnegative allocation weights summing to one within 1e-9.
    cash: Finite, nonnegative cash included in portfolio equity; defaults to zero.
    fractional_shares: Whether to allow fractional desired holdings; defaults to rounding desired holdings down.

Returns:
    A tuple of share changes by symbol (positive buys, negative sells) and remaining cash, clamped to zero.

Raises:
    ValueError: If cash, weights, relevant prices, or holdings are invalid, targets are empty, weights do not sum to one within 1e-9, or equity or a desired share count is nonfinite.
    KeyError: If a held or targeted symbol has no price.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a symbol's market value as a fraction of total portfolio market value.

Args:
    symbol: Symbol whose portfolio weight to calculate.

Returns:
    The holding's market value divided by total market value, or Decimal zero if either is zero.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the line subtotal rounded using the invoice's currency quantum.

Multiply quantity by unit price and quantize the result with ROUND_HALF_UP rounding.

Args:
    quantity: Nonnegative number of units.
    unit_price: Nonnegative price per unit as a Decimal.

Returns:
    The subtotal as a Decimal, quantized using the invoice's currency quantum.

Raises:
    ValueError: If quantity or unit_price is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Convert a currency amount, deduct a fee, and round half up.

Currency codes are stripped and uppercased before validation. Matching codes use a rate of one without querying the client, but still yield control asynchronously.

Args:
    client: Client whose asynchronous get_fx_rate method supplies the exchange rate for differing currencies.
    amount: Finite, nonnegative Decimal amount to convert.
    source: Source currency code, requiring three ASCII letters after stripping and uppercasing.
    target: Target currency code, requiring three ASCII letters after stripping and uppercasing.
    fee_rate: Finite Decimal fraction deducted after conversion, from zero inclusive to one exclusive; defaults to zero.
    minor_units: Decimal places for rounding, from zero through six; defaults to two.

Returns:
    The converted Decimal amount after fee deduction, rounded half up to minor_units decimal places.

Raises:
    ValueError: If normalized currency codes are invalid, amount or fee_rate is invalid, minor_units is outside zero through six, or the fetched rate is nonfinite or nonpositive.
label: correct

docstring:
Build a monthly loan repayment schedule.

Stop when the balance reaches zero; the final allowed payment covers the entire remaining balance and interest, regardless of the payment budget. Yield control to the event loop before the first payment and every hundredth payment.

Args:
    principal: Finite, positive initial loan balance.
    annual_rate: Finite, nonnegative annual interest rate, divided by twelve for the monthly rate.
    payments: Positive maximum number of monthly payments, also used to calculate the scheduled payment.
    monthly_extra: Finite, nonnegative amount added to the scheduled payment; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries containing month, payment, interest, principal paid, and remaining balance.

Raises:
    ValueError: If principal is nonfinite or nonpositive, annual_rate or monthly_extra is nonfinite or negative, payments is nonpositive, or the calculated payment budget or amount due is nonfinite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the fee-adjusted currency conversion rounded half up.

Convert using source and target units per base currency, then deduct the fee. Round to the exponent of the target currency's configured quantum.

Args:
    amount: Finite, nonnegative amount in the source currency.
    source: Source currency key in the exchange rate mapping.
    target: Target currency key in the exchange rate and rounding quantum mappings.
    fee_rate: Finite fee fraction from zero inclusive to one exclusive; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    The converted Decimal amount after fees, quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP to the target quantum's exponent.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the amount is nonfinite or negative, the fee is nonfinite or outside [0, 1), or either exchange rate is nonfinite or nonpositive.
    KeyError: If either currency lacks an exchange rate or the target lacks a rounding quantum.
label: correct

docstring:
Return word and optional number tokens in their original order.

Words may contain internal straight or curly apostrophes; numbers may contain dots or commas between digit groups. Underscores and other separators are excluded.

Args:
    text: Text to tokenize.
    include_numbers: Whether to retain numeric tokens; defaults to True.
    lowercase: Whether to lowercase tokens; defaults to False.

Returns:
    A list of matched tokens, optionally excluding numbers and lowercasing tokens.
label: correct

docstring:
Collapse whitespace and optionally lowercase the text.

Args:
    text: Text whose whitespace is normalized.
    lowercase: Whether to lowercase the result; defaults to False.

Returns:
    Text with surrounding whitespace removed and whitespace runs replaced by single spaces, optionally lowercased.
label: correct

docstring:
Propose rounded trade values to rebalance holdings toward target weights.

Capital includes available cash and current holdings; symbols without target weights have a zero target. Trade values are rounded using the currency quantum and ROUND_HALF_UP, then filtered by minimum magnitude.

Args:
    target_weights: Target weights by symbol, each between zero and one, totaling at most one.
    cash: Finite, nonnegative available cash included in capital; defaults to zero.
    minimum_trade: Minimum absolute rounded trade value to include; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    A dictionary mapping symbols to nonzero Decimal trade values: positive for buys, negative for sells. Empty if capital is zero or no trades qualify.

Raises:
    ValueError: If cash or minimum_trade is nonfinite or negative, weights are invalid or total above one, prices are nonfinite or nonpositive, or quantities are nonfinite or negative.
    KeyError: If a held or targeted symbol lacks a market price.
label: correct

docstring:
Apply a payment to selected invoices in order and return allocations.

Update outstanding balances for invoices receiving payment; omit zero allocations from the result. Add any permitted excess to the credit balance.

Args:
    amount: Finite, nonnegative payment amount.
    invoice_ids: Invoice IDs in payment order; None selects all outstanding invoices in their existing order.
    allow_credit: Whether to add excess payment to credit; False rejects payments exceeding the selected total.

Returns:
    A mapping of invoice IDs to positive payment amounts applied.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the payment is nonfinite or negative, selections contain duplicates, selected balances are nonfinite or negative, excess payment is disallowed, or existing credit is nonfinite or negative when excess is added.
    KeyError: If a selected invoice ID is not in outstanding invoices.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield each price's index and change from the preceding price.

Args:
    prices: Prices in sequence order.

Yields:
    A tuple of the index, starting at 1, and the current price minus the preceding price.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield monthly interest and updated balances for twelve months.

Args:
    balance: Starting balance on which monthly interest is calculated.
    annual_rate: Annual interest rate as a fraction, divided by twelve for the monthly rate.

Yields:
    Tuples containing the month number (1–12), monthly interest, and balance after adding that interest.
label: correct

docstring:
Parse backslash-escaped assignments into a dictionary.

Backslashes escape any following character, and the first unescaped equals sign separates each key from its value. Keys and values are stripped of surrounding whitespace; blank segments without an equals sign are ignored.

Args:
    text: Assignment text to parse.
    separator: Single-character assignment delimiter, excluding backslash and equals; defaults to semicolon.
    allow_duplicates: Whether later assignments overwrite duplicate keys; defaults to rejecting duplicates.

Returns:
    A dictionary mapping stripped keys to stripped values, with escape backslashes removed.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the separator is invalid, an escape is incomplete, an assignment lacks an equals sign or has an empty key, or a duplicate key is disallowed.
label: correct

docstring:
Return merged context snippets around literal query matches.

Overlapping or touching context windows are merged; max_matches limits matches processed, not snippets returned. Matches are non-overlapping, and whole-word matching requires no adjacent word characters.

Args:
    text: Text to search.
    query: Nonempty literal string to find.
    context: Nonnegative characters included on each side of a match; defaults to 30.
    case_sensitive: Whether matching respects case; defaults to False.
    whole_words: Whether matches require no adjacent word characters; defaults to False.
    max_matches: Positive maximum number of matches processed; defaults to 100.

Returns:
    A list of (start, end, snippet) tuples with exclusive end offsets, or an empty list if unmatched.

Raises:
    ValueError: If query is empty, context is negative, or max_matches is less than 1.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield due dates and amounts for invoice installments.

Round the total to cents using half-up rounding and regular installments down to cents, assigning the remainder to the last installment. Validation occurs when iteration begins.

Args:
    total: Finite, nonnegative invoice total.
    installments: Positive number of installments.
    first_due: Due date of the first installment.
    interval_days: Nonnegative days between due dates; defaults to 30.

Yields:
    A (due_date, amount) tuple for each installment, with dates spaced by interval_days.

Raises:
    ValueError: If total is nonfinite or negative, installments is below one, or interval_days is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the Monday on or before the given date.

Args:
    day: Date whose week's Monday to find.

Returns:
    The date of Monday in the same week as day.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield currency conversions after subtracting a fee and rounding half up.

Validation occurs when the generator is iterated, and each amount is validated as it is consumed.

Args:
    amounts: Source amounts, each finite and nonnegative.
    exchange_rate: Finite, positive rate multiplied by each source amount.
    fee: Finite, nonnegative fee subtracted from each converted amount; defaults to zero.
    decimal_places: Decimal places for rounding, from zero through eight; defaults to two.

Yields:
    Each converted amount minus the fee, rounded half up to the specified decimal places.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the exchange rate is nonfinite or nonpositive, or the fee is nonfinite or negative.
    ValueError: If decimal_places is outside zero through eight.
    ValueError: If a source amount is nonfinite or negative, or its converted amount is below the fee.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield monthly loan amortization entries until the balance is repaid.

Round principal, monthly payment, interest, and extra payments to cents using half-up rounding, capping payments at the outstanding balance plus interest. Validation occurs when iteration begins.

Args:
    principal: Finite, positive initial loan balance that rounds to at least one cent.
    annual_rate: Finite, nonnegative annual interest rate, divided by twelve to obtain the monthly rate.
    monthly_payment: Finite, positive regular monthly payment that rounds to at least one cent.
    extra_payments: Positive integer months mapped to finite, nonnegative additional payments; None means no extras.
    max_months: Maximum number of monthly entries before repayment must finish; defaults to 600.

Yields:
    Tuples of one-based month number, interest charged, principal paid, and remaining balance.

Raises:
    ValueError: If principal or monthly payment is nonfinite, nonpositive, or rounds to zero; annual rate is nonfinite or negative; max_months is less than one; extra-payment months are not positive integers; extra amounts are nonfinite or negative; or a scheduled payment does not exceed interest.
    TimeoutError: If the loan remains unpaid after max_months entries.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the number of days between two dates, including both endpoints.

Args:
    start: First date in the inclusive range.
    end: Last date in the inclusive range.

Returns:
    The number of days in the inclusive date range.

Raises:
    ValueError: If end precedes start.
label: correct

docstring:
Return monthly pay dates on or after the reference date.

Clamp the payday to each month's last day when necessary.

Args:
    reference: Earliest date to include.
    payday: Desired day of the month, from 1 through 31; defaults to 25.
    count: Number of dates to return; defaults to six, with zero returning an empty list.

Returns:
    A chronological list of count monthly pay dates on or after reference.

Raises:
    ValueError: If payday is outside 1 through 31 or count is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield trades that rebalance holdings to target portfolio weights.

Portfolio value includes cash, and holdings absent from target_weights receive a zero target. Validation occurs when iteration begins; sells precede buys, with symbols sorted alphabetically within each group.

Args:
    holdings: Mapping of symbols to finite, nonnegative share counts.
    prices: Mapping providing finite, positive prices for every held or targeted symbol.
    target_weights: Nonempty mapping of finite weights between zero and one, summing to one within 1e-9.
    cash: Finite, nonnegative cash included in portfolio value; defaults to zero.
    minimum_trade_value: Finite, nonnegative threshold excluding smaller absolute trade values; zero excludes only zero-value trades.

Yields:
    Tuples of (symbol, signed share change, signed trade value), negative for sells and positive for buys.

Raises:
    ValueError: If cash, minimum_trade_value, weights, prices, or holdings violate their constraints, target_weights is empty or its sum differs from one by more than 1e-9, or portfolio value is nonfinite.
    KeyError: If a held or targeted symbol has no price.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the first and last dates of the month containing day.

Args:
    day: Date whose month boundaries to determine.

Returns:
    A tuple containing the month's first and last dates, in that order.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the seconds until the target, rounded up and clamped to zero.

Args:
    target: Target datetime whose timezone is used to obtain the current time.

Returns:
    The remaining seconds as an integer, rounded up, or zero if the target has passed.
label: correct

docstring:
Resolve a local appointment to a time-zone-aware datetime.

Reject nonexistent local times and ignore the clock's fold value. For ambiguous times, reject by default or select the earlier or later UTC instant.

Args:
    day: Local appointment date.
    clock: Local appointment time without tzinfo; its fold value is ignored.
    zone_name: Time zone name passed to ZoneInfo.
    ambiguity: Ambiguous-time policy: "reject" (default), "earlier", or "later", ordered by UTC instant.

Returns:
    A datetime in the requested time zone representing the resolved appointment.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the ambiguity policy is invalid, clock has tzinfo, the zone is unknown, or the local time is nonexistent or ambiguous with rejection selected.
label: correct

docstring:
Return sorted UTC bookings merged by overlap, touching, or allowed gap.

Zero-duration bookings are discarded. Positive separations up to gap are merged regardless of merge_touching.

Args:
    bookings: Time-zone-aware start and end pairs to normalize and merge.
    gap: Maximum positive separation to merge; defaults to zero.
    merge_touching: Whether to merge bookings with coincident endpoints; defaults to True.

Returns:
    A sorted list of merged start and end tuples with UTC endpoints.

Raises:
    ValueError: If gap is negative, an endpoint lacks time-zone awareness, or an end precedes its start.
label: correct

docstring:
Shift a date by a signed number of business days.

Exclude the starting date from counting; return it unchanged when days is zero. Skip weekends and supplied holidays.

Args:
    start: Starting date to shift.
    days: Business days to shift; positive moves forward, negative backward, and zero returns start unchanged.
    holidays: Dates to exclude from business days; None excludes no additional dates.

Returns:
    The date reached after shifting by the requested number of business days.
label: correct

docstring:
Read nonempty lines from a file, stripping surrounding whitespace.

Args:
    path: Path to the file to read.
    encoding: Text encoding used to read the file; defaults to UTF-8.

Returns:
    A list of stripped, nonempty lines in file order.
label: correct

docstring:
Advance a date by a signed number of business days.

Exclude the starting date when counting; zero days returns it unchanged. Skip weekends and supplied holidays in either direction.

Args:
    start: Starting date.
    days: Integer business-day count; negative values move backward, and zero leaves the date unchanged.
    holidays: Dates to skip in addition to weekends; defaults to an empty set.

Returns:
    The date reached after counting the requested business days.

Raises:
    TypeError: If days is a boolean or not an integer.
label: correct

docstring:
Resolve a naive wall time to an aware datetime in the requested zone.

Ambiguous times are selected by earlier or later UTC instant. Forward shifting selects the earliest UTC instant among round-trip results whose wall times exceed the input.

Args:
    wall: Naive datetime representing the local wall time.
    zone: Time zone key passed to ZoneInfo.
    ambiguous: Policy for repeated times: 'raise' (default), 'earlier', or 'later'.
    nonexistent: Policy for missing times: 'raise' (default) or 'shift_forward'.

Returns:
    An aware datetime in the requested zone, resolving or shifting the supplied wall time.

Raises:
    ValueError: If wall has tzinfo, either policy is invalid, an ambiguous or nonexistent time requires raising, or no forward adjustment is available.
label: correct

docstring:
Write a dictionary as UTF-8 JSON and return the payload's byte count.

Use two-space indentation, preserve non-ASCII characters, and append a newline; reject non-finite floats. Overwrite the destination file if it exists.

Args:
    path: Destination file path.
    data: Dictionary to serialize as JSON.

Returns:
    The byte length of the UTF-8 payload, including the trailing newline.
label: correct

docstring:
Read selected CSV columns into a list of dictionaries.

Read using UTF-8 with optional BOM handling, preserving field whitespace. When skip_blank is true, omit records whose selected fields are all whitespace or empty.

Args:
    path: Path to the CSV file.
    columns: Column names to include in each returned dictionary.
    skip_blank: Whether to omit records with only blank selected fields; defaults to true.
    delimiter: Single-character field separator; defaults to a comma.

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries mapping selected column names to string values, in file order.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the delimiter is not one character, requested columns are missing, headers repeat, or records have mismatched field counts.
label: correct

docstring:
Merge busy periods that overlap or are separated by at most the gap.

Args:
    periods: Start and end datetime pairs to sort and merge.
    gap: Maximum separation to merge; defaults to zero, merging overlapping or touching periods.

Returns:
    A new, chronologically sorted list of merged start and end datetime pairs.

Raises:
    ValueError: If gap is negative or a period ends before it starts.
label: correct

docstring:
Append a message to the log file with one trailing newline.

Create missing parent directories and strip trailing carriage returns and newlines from the message before appending a newline.

Args:
    message: Text to append to the log file.

Returns:
    The number of characters written, including the appended newline.
label: correct

docstring:
Load a configuration section and merge it over supplied defaults.

Read the file as UTF-8, preserving option case and disabling interpolation. Named sections include file-level defaults; loaded values override supplied defaults.

Args:
    path: Path to the configuration file.
    section: Section to load, including the parser's default section.
    defaults: Initial settings to copy before merging loaded values; None starts with an empty dictionary.

Returns:
    A new dictionary containing supplied defaults overridden by the loaded section's settings.

Raises:
    KeyError: If the requested section is neither the default section nor an existing named section.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the deadline after adding hours within weekday business hours.

Skip weekends and holidays, advancing starts outside business hours to the next opening. If hours rounds to a zero timedelta, return opened unchanged after validation.

Args:
    opened: Naive local start datetime.
    hours: Finite, nonnegative number of business hours to add.
    opening: Naive daily opening time; defaults to 09:00.
    closing: Naive daily closing time, later than opening; defaults to 17:00.
    holidays: Dates excluded from business hours; defaults to an empty frozenset.

Returns:
    A naive local deadline datetime, possibly exactly at closing time.

Raises:
    ValueError: If opened, opening, or closing has non-None tzinfo, closing is not later than opening, or hours is nonfinite or negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Read CSV records as dictionaries after validating headers and row lengths.

Read using UTF-8 with an optional byte-order mark. Reject rows with more or fewer fields than the header.

Args:
    path: Path to the CSV file.
    required_columns: Column names that must appear in the header; defaults to none.
    delimiter: Single-character field separator; defaults to a comma.

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries mapping header names to string field values.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the delimiter is not one character, headers are absent or duplicated, required columns are missing, or row lengths differ from the header.
label: correct

docstring:
Resolve a relative path within an existing workspace directory.

Resolve symlinks and reject paths that escape the workspace. Check the requested kind only if the resolved path exists.

Args:
    root: Existing workspace directory to resolve strictly.
    relative_path: Unanchored relative path to resolve within the workspace.
    must_exist: Whether to require the resolved path to exist; defaults to False.
    kind: Required kind for existing paths: 'any' (default), 'file', or 'directory'.

Returns:
    The resolved absolute Path within the workspace.

Raises:
    ValueError: If kind is invalid, the path is anchored or escapes, or an existing file-kind path is not a regular file.
    NotADirectoryError: If the workspace is not a directory or an existing directory-kind path is not a directory.
    FileNotFoundError: If must_exist is True and the resolved path does not exist.
label: correct

docstring:
Concatenate source files in order and atomically publish the destination.

Copy bytes without separators into a temporary file in the destination directory, then flush and synchronize it before publishing. Remove the temporary file afterward, including on failure.

Args:
    sources: One or more source file paths, concatenated in the supplied order.
    destination: Destination file path whose parent directory must exist.
    overwrite: Whether to replace an existing destination; defaults to rejecting existing destinations.

Returns:
    The total number of bytes copied from the sources.

Raises:
    ValueError: If no sources are supplied, a source is not a regular file, or a source resolves to the destination.
    FileNotFoundError: If the destination parent is not a directory or a source does not exist.
    IsADirectoryError: If the destination is a directory.
    FileExistsError: If the destination exists, including a dangling symlink, and overwrite is false.
label: correct

docstring:
Update an INI section and return the number of changed options.

Preserve option-name case and disable interpolation, creating the section and parent directories as needed. Rewrite the file in UTF-8 even when no options change.

Args:
    path: Path to the INI file to read and rewrite.
    updates: Option names and string values to set in the section.
    section: Section to update; defaults to "general".

Returns:
    The number of options added or assigned a value different from their existing effective value.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the section name is empty.
label: correct

docstring:
Save data as UTF-8 JSON and atomically replace the destination.

Create missing parent directories, append a newline, and preserve an existing destination's permission bits. When requested, copy an existing destination to a .bak file before replacement.

Args:
    path: Destination file path; symbolic links and existing nonregular files are rejected.
    data: Object to serialize as JSON with non-ASCII characters preserved and nonfinite numbers disallowed.
    indent: Nonnegative integer indentation width, or None; defaults to 2.
    backup: Whether to back up an existing destination to .bak; defaults to False.

Returns:
    The destination as a Path.

Raises:
    TypeError: If indent is neither None nor an integer, or is a boolean.
    ValueError: If indent is negative, or the destination is a symbolic link or existing nonregular file.
    FileExistsError: If backing up an existing destination and the backup path exists or is a symbolic link.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield nonblank file lines with trailing carriage returns and newlines removed.

Preserve other whitespace in yielded lines.

Args:
    path: Path to the file to read.
    encoding: Encoding used to read the file; defaults to UTF-8.

Yields:
    Each line with trailing carriage returns and newlines removed, excluding empty or whitespace-only lines.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield batches of rows from a UTF-8 CSV file.

A leading UTF-8 BOM is removed. The final batch may contain fewer rows than batch_size.

Args:
    path: Path to the CSV file to read.
    batch_size: Maximum rows per batch; must be positive, defaults to 100.
    skip_header: Whether to skip the first CSV row; defaults to False.

Yields:
    Lists of CSV rows, each row a list of strings.

Raises:
    ValueError: If batch_size is nonpositive.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a path-sorted inventory of regular files in a directory.

Exclude symbolic links and skip entries that disappear before metadata is read. Hidden filtering checks every component of each relative path; suffix matching is case-insensitive.

Args:
    root: Directory to inventory.
    recursive: Search all descendants if true; otherwise inspect only immediate children.
    include_hidden: Include paths with dot-prefixed components if true; exclude them by default.
    suffixes: Allowed final suffixes, each beginning with a dot; empty allows all suffixes.
    minimum_size: Minimum file size in bytes, inclusive; defaults to zero.

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries sorted by path, containing relative POSIX path, size, and modified_ns timestamp.

Raises:
    TypeError: If minimum_size is a boolean or not an integer.
    ValueError: If minimum_size is negative or any suffix is empty or lacks a leading dot.
    FileNotFoundError: If root does not exist.
    NotADirectoryError: If root is not a directory.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield JSON objects parsed from nonblank lines in a file.

Args:
    path: Path to the file containing one JSON object per nonblank line.
    skip_invalid: Whether to skip malformed JSON and non-object values instead of raising; defaults to False.
    encoding: Encoding used to read the file; defaults to utf-8.

Yields:
    A dictionary for each nonblank line containing a valid JSON object.

Raises:
    ValueError: If a nonblank line contains malformed JSON or a non-object value and skip_invalid is False.
label: correct

docstring:
Pause for the given duration and return the completion time in UTC.

Args:
    duration: Nonnegative duration to pause for.

Returns:
    The timezone-aware UTC datetime recorded after the pause.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the duration is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield section, key, and value tuples from a configuration file.

Ignore blank lines and lines beginning with '#' or ';' after stripping whitespace. Entries before any section header use an empty section name; section names, keys, and values are stripped of surrounding whitespace.

Args:
    path: Path to the configuration file.
    allow_duplicates: Whether to allow repeated keys within the same section; defaults to False.
    encoding: Encoding used to read the file; defaults to UTF-8.

Yields:
    A (section, key, value) tuple for each assignment, in file order.

Raises:
    ValueError: If a section is unclosed, empty, or contains brackets; an assignment lacks '=' or a key; or a duplicate section/key pair is disallowed.
label: correct

docstring:
Fetch an article and return its publication date.

Args:
    client: Client whose asynchronous fetch_article method retrieves the article.
    article_id: Identifier of the article to fetch.

Returns:
    The date extracted from the article's ISO-formatted published_at timestamp.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield files directly within a directory in name-sorted order.

Args:
    directory: Path to the directory whose immediate files are yielded.

Yields:
    Path objects for immediate entries that are files, sorted by entry name.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield binary records from a file starting at a byte offset.

A final short record raises an error, is discarded, or is yielded according to incomplete.

Args:
    path: Path to the binary file to read.
    record_size: Positive number of bytes per complete record.
    offset: Nonnegative starting byte offset; defaults to the beginning of the file.
    incomplete: Final short record policy: 'error' (default), 'drop', or 'keep'.

Yields:
    Record bytes, including a final short record only when incomplete is 'keep'.

Raises:
    ValueError: If record_size is nonpositive, offset is negative, incomplete is invalid, or a short record occurs with incomplete='error'.
label: correct

docstring:
Wait until the next occurrence of a daily UTC time and return its datetime.

If today's target is at or before the supplied current time, wait for tomorrow's target.

Args:
    run_at: Naive daily time interpreted as UTC.
    now: Timezone-aware current datetime; defaults to the actual current UTC datetime.

Returns:
    The target timezone-aware UTC datetime after sleeping for the calculated delay.

Raises:
    ValueError: If run_at has tzinfo or now has no UTC offset.
label: correct

docstring:
Return free UTC calendar intervals within the requested window.

Fetch busy intervals over the window extended by the buffer, then expand each nonempty booking by the buffer and clip it to the window. Ignore zero-length bookings and combine overlapping or touching blocked intervals.

Args:
    client: Client providing an awaitable fetch_busy method returning booking boundary pairs.
    window_start: Timezone-aware start of the requested window.
    window_end: Timezone-aware end of the requested window, strictly after its start.
    buffer: Nonnegative padding around bookings; defaults to no padding.

Returns:
    A chronologically ordered list of UTC datetime pairs representing free intervals, possibly empty.

Raises:
    ValueError: If window or booking boundaries are timezone-naive, the window end is not after its start, the buffer is negative, or a booking ends before it starts.
label: correct

docstring:
Count weekdays excluding holidays fetched from the client.

Args:
    start: Start date, included if it is a nonholiday weekday before end.
    end: End date, excluded unless include_end is true.
    client: Client whose asynchronous fetch_holidays(start, end) returns ISO-format holiday date strings.
    include_end: Whether to count end if it is a nonholiday weekday; defaults to false.

Returns:
    The number of nonholiday weekdays in the specified date range.

Raises:
    ValueError: If end precedes start.
label: correct

docstring:
Poll an event until its scheduled start time is reached.

Only pending and scheduled statuses are accepted; cancelled events are rejected. Scheduled start timestamps must be timezone-aware and are converted to UTC.

Args:
    client: Client providing an asynchronous fetch_event method.
    event_id: Identifier of the event to poll.
    timeout: Finite, positive overall timeout in seconds; defaults to 30.
    poll_interval: Finite, positive maximum delay between polls in seconds; defaults to 1.

Returns:
    The scheduled start datetime in UTC once that time has been reached.

Raises:
    ValueError: If timeout or poll_interval is nonfinite or nonpositive, status is cancelled or unsupported, or starts_at is naive.
    TimeoutError: If the deadline expires or an event lookup raises TimeoutError.
    KeyError: If a scheduled event lacks starts_at.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield the requested number of business dates starting at or after start.

Args:
    start: First date to consider, included if it is a business date.
    count: Number of business dates to yield; zero yields no dates.
    holidays: Dates to exclude in addition to weekends; None excludes only weekends.

Yields:
    Successive dates that fall Monday through Friday and are not in holidays.

Raises:
    ValueError: If count is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield consecutive intervals spanning a time window.

For aware datetimes, measure intervals in UTC and yield endpoints in start's time zone. An empty window yields nothing.

Args:
    start: Inclusive window start; determines the output time zone for aware datetimes.
    end: Window end; must match start's awareness and not precede it.
    width: Positive interval duration; defaults to one hour.
    keep_partial: Whether to yield a final interval shorter than width; defaults to True.

Yields:
    Pairs of interval start and end datetimes, with the final interval capped at end.

Raises:
    ValueError: If width is nonpositive.
    ValueError: If start and end differ in timezone awareness.
    ValueError: If end precedes start.
label: correct

docstring:
Write a dictionary as UTF-8 JSON and return the target path.

Use two-space indentation, preserve non-ASCII characters, and append a newline. Write in a worker thread, overwriting any existing file.

Args:
    path: Destination file path.
    data: Dictionary to serialize as JSON.

Returns:
    The destination as a Path object.
label: correct

docstring:
Read a text file asynchronously and return its lines.

Read the file in a worker thread and split its contents without retaining line endings.

Args:
    path: Path to the text file to read.
    encoding: Text encoding used to read the file; defaults to UTF-8.

Returns:
    A list of lines without line endings.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield consecutive dates starting with the given date.

Args:
    start: First date to yield.
    count: Number of dates to yield; zero yields nothing.

Yields:
    Successive dates starting at start, one day apart.

Raises:
    ValueError: If count is negative.
label: correct

docstring:
Load CSV records asynchronously from a UTF-8 file.

A leading UTF-8 BOM is stripped, and the first row supplies column names. Missing row values become None; surplus values are collected in a list under the None key.

Args:
    path: Path to the CSV file.
    delimiter: Single-character field separator; defaults to a comma.
    required_columns: Column names required in the header; defaults to no requirements.

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries mapping column names to row values.

Raises:
    ValueError: If delimiter is not exactly one character.
    KeyError: If any required column is absent from the header.
label: correct

docstring:
Copy a file into a directory, preserving its name and metadata.

Create the destination directory and any missing parents. Run filesystem operations in worker threads.

Args:
    source: Path to the existing file to copy.
    directory: Destination directory path.
    overwrite: Whether to replace an existing destination file; defaults to False.

Returns:
    The destination Path, formed from the directory and source filename.

Raises:
    ValueError: If source and destination resolve to the same path.
    FileNotFoundError: If the source is not an existing file.
    IsADirectoryError: If the destination is a directory.
    FileExistsError: If the destination exists and overwrite is False.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield monthly payment dates within an inclusive date range.

Missing days are clamped to month-end, skipped, or rejected according to missing_day. Validation occurs during iteration; rejection checks every visited month, even if its payment date would fall outside the range.

Args:
    start: Inclusive lower date bound.
    end: Inclusive upper date bound.
    day_of_month: Requested payment day from 1 through 31; defaults to 31.
    missing_day: Missing-day policy: "clamp" (default), "skip", or "raise".

Yields:
    Payment dates in chronological order, at most one per month, within the inclusive bounds.

Raises:
    ValueError: If day_of_month is outside 1 through 31, missing_day is invalid, end precedes start, or a visited month lacks the requested day under the "raise" policy.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield zoned daily occurrences of a local time.

Ambiguous times yield both occurrences in UTC order by default; nonexistent times are skipped. Validation occurs when iteration begins.

Args:
    start: First local date to consider.
    days: Nonnegative number of consecutive local dates to consider.
    local_time: Time without timezone information to use on each date.
    zone: Time zone name passed to ZoneInfo.
    ambiguous: Ambiguous-time policy: both (default), earlier, later, or raise, ordered by UTC instant.
    nonexistent: Nonexistent-time policy: skip (default) or raise.

Yields:
    Timezone-aware datetimes in the requested zone for each selected occurrence.

Raises:
    ValueError: If days is negative, local_time has timezone information, either policy is invalid, zone lookup raises KeyError, or an ambiguous or nonexistent time has policy 'raise'.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the arithmetic mean of values converted to floats.

Args:
    values: Nonempty list of values convertible to finite floats.

Returns:
    The mean, computed by summing each converted value divided by the list length.

Raises:
    ValueError: If values is empty or any converted value is not finite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return trailing moving averages of nonmissing values.

Windows include the current position and up to window minus one preceding positions. Missing values are excluded; results are None when too few nonmissing values are available.

Args:
    values: Values converted to floats, with None representing missing observations.
    window: Positive integer number of positions per trailing window; booleans are rejected.
    min_periods: Required nonmissing count, from one through window; defaults to window; booleans are rejected.

Returns:
    A list matching the input length, containing each trailing average or None.

Raises:
    ValueError: If window is a boolean, not an integer, or less than one.
    ValueError: If min_periods is a boolean, not an integer, or outside one through window.
    ValueError: If any converted nonmissing value is not finite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return indices of values strictly outside the selected IQR fences.

Compute quartiles by linear interpolation in the sorted, float-converted values. Fence equality is not considered an outlier.

Args:
    values: Values to convert to floats and test for outliers.
    multiplier: Finite, nonnegative IQR padding factor; defaults to 1.5.
    side: Fences to test: "both" (default), "low", or "high".

Returns:
    Zero-based outlier indices in the original input order.

Raises:
    ValueError: If multiplier is nonfinite or negative, side is invalid, values are empty or nonfinite, or IQR is nonfinite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return the median of values converted to finite floats.

Args:
    values: Nonempty list of values to convert to finite floats and sort.

Returns:
    The middle float for odd lengths, or the sum of half each middle float for even lengths.

Raises:
    ValueError: If values is empty or any converted value is not finite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a sample percentile using interpolation or a neighboring value.

Values are converted to floats and sorted; the position is (n - 1) * percentile / 100. The method selects linear interpolation or the value at the lower or higher neighboring index.

Args:
    values: Nonempty list of values that convert to finite floats.
    percentile: Finite percentile between 0 and 100, inclusive.
    method: Selection method: "linear" (default), "lower", or "higher".

Returns:
    The computed percentile as a float.

Raises:
    ValueError: If values is empty, percentile is nonfinite or outside [0, 100], method is unsupported, or converted values are nonfinite.
label: correct

docstring:
Yield decreasing durations from the total down to zero.

Args:
    total: Nonnegative duration to start the countdown.
    step: Positive duration to subtract between yields, clamping the result to zero.

Yields:
    Remaining durations, starting at total and ending with zero exactly once.

Raises:
    ValueError: If total is negative or step is nonpositive.
label: correct

docstring:
Return unique labels in order of first occurrence.

Args:
    labels: Labels to deduplicate.

Returns:
    A list of distinct labels preserving their first-occurrence order.
label: correct

docstring:
Return weighted bin totals or probability densities for the given values.

Ignore values outside the edge range; bins include their left edge but exclude their right edge, except the last bin includes both. Density normalization uses only weight inside the bins.

Args:
    values: Finite values to bin, converted to floats.
    edges: At least two finite, strictly increasing bin boundaries, converted to floats.
    weights: Finite, nonnegative weights matching values; None assigns unit weight to each value.
    density: Whether to normalize bin totals by included weight and bin width; defaults to False.

Returns:
    A list of weighted bin totals, or normalized densities when density is True.

Raises:
    ValueError: If fewer than two edges are provided, or edges are nonfinite or not strictly increasing.
    ValueError: If values are nonfinite.
    ValueError: If weights have the wrong length, are nonfinite, or are negative.
    ValueError: If an accumulated bin weight exceeds the floating-point range.
    ValueError: If density is requested without positive weight inside the bins.
    ValueError: If density is requested and a bin width exceeds the floating-point range.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a new list with strings stripped and empty strings replaced by None.

Args:
    values: Values to clean; non-string values remain unchanged.

Returns:
    A new list with surrounding string whitespace removed and resulting empty strings replaced by None.
label: correct

docstring:
Read an INI section asynchronously and validate required keys.

Read UTF-8 text with optional BOM, disable interpolation, and return lowercase keys including inherited defaults. Required keys are matched case-insensitively, and whitespace-only required values are rejected.

Args:
    path: Path to the INI file.
    section: Section name to select; must be nonblank and not DEFAULT.
    defaults: Initial configuration defaults; None supplies no initial defaults.
    required_keys: Keys required to exist with nonblank values; empty tuple requires none.

Returns:
    A dictionary of the section's values, including inherited defaults, with lowercase keys.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the section name is blank or DEFAULT, INI parsing fails, or a required value is blank.
    KeyError: If the section does not exist or required keys are missing.
label: correct

docstring:
Return copied records with the specified column coerced to integers.

Accept integers except booleans, finite integral floats, and stripped strings parsed by int. Set missing or unconvertible values to fallback, leaving the original records unchanged.

Args:
    records: Records to shallow-copy and update.
    column: Column to convert or insert in each copied record.
    fallback: Replacement for missing or unconvertible values; defaults to None.

Returns:
    A list of shallow-copied records with the specified column containing converted integers or fallback.
label: correct

docstring:
Return records with column names replaced according to the mapping.

Unmapped columns are retained by default. Duplicate target names within a record raise an error, including collisions with retained unmapped columns.

Args:
    records: Records whose column names will be mapped.
    mapping: Mapping from source column names to target column names.
    keep_unmapped: Whether to retain unmapped columns under their original names; defaults to True.

Returns:
    A new list of new record dictionaries with mapped names and unchanged values.

Raises:
    ValueError: If multiple columns in a record produce the same target name.
label: correct

docstring:
Return a percentile of the sample using the selected interpolation method.

Positions are computed as percentile / 100 * (sample size - 1) after converting values to floats and sorting them. The nearest method rounds halfway positions to the even index.

Args:
    values: Sample values to convert to floats and sort; must be nonempty and finite.
    percentile: Finite percentile between 0 and 100 inclusive; defaults to 50.
    method: Interpolation method: linear (default), lower, higher, nearest, or midpoint.

Returns:
    The percentile value as a float.

Raises:
    ValueError: If method is unsupported, percentile is nonfinite or outside [0, 100], or values are empty or nonfinite.
label: correct

docstring:
Return histogram counts or probability densities for the given bin edges.

Bins include their left edge and exclude their right edge, except the final bin includes both. Out-of-range samples are ignored; density normalization uses only counted samples and leaves empty histograms unchanged.

Args:
    values: Sample values to convert to floats and count.
    edges: Bin boundaries to convert to finite, strictly increasing floats; at least two required.
    density: Whether to divide counts by the counted sample total and bin widths; defaults to false.

Returns:
    A list of floating-point bin counts, or normalized densities when density is true.

Raises:
    ValueError: If fewer than two edges are provided, edges are nonfinite or nonincreasing, or samples are nonfinite.
label: correct

docstring:
Strip whitespace and replace missing-text tokens with None.

Missing tokens are empty strings, "null", "none", "n/a", and "na", matched case-insensitively; existing None values remain None.

Args:
    values: Strings or None values to normalize.

Returns:
    A new list of stripped strings or None values, preserving input order.
label: correct

docstring:
Merge records sharing an identity into copied dictionaries.

Preserve first-seen identity order and make shallow copies without modifying input records. Add missing columns, replace existing None values with non-None values, and ignore incoming None values for existing columns.

Args:
    records: Record dictionaries to consolidate.
    key_column: Column containing each record's non-None, hashable identity.
    conflict: Unequal non-None value policy: 'error' raises (default), 'first' keeps existing, 'last' replaces.

Returns:
    A list of merged dictionaries, one per distinct identity, in first-seen order.

docstring:

docstring:
Return an unexpired cached value or compute it with the loader.

Args:

docstring:
Return a cached result or call the function and cache its result.

Expiration starts when the call completes; cache hits move entries to the end without extending expiration. A zero TTL bypasses caching; successful misses remove expired entries and evict oldest entries to enforce the limit.

Args:
    cache: Mutable dictionary mapping call keys to expiration times and results, ordered for eviction.

    args: Positional arguments passed to the callable and included in the cache key.
    ttl: Finite, nonnegative cache lifetime in seconds; defaults to 60.0; zero bypasses caching.
    max_entries: Positive cache size limit enforced after insertion; defaults to 128.
    kwargs: Keyword arguments passed to the callable; sorted items form part of the cache key.

Returns:
    The unexpired cached result or the result of invoking the callable.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ttl is nonfinite or negative, max_entries is below one, or computed expiration is nonfinite.

label: correct

docstring:

docstring:

docstring:
Resize the LRU cache and return removed keys.

docstring:
Remove expired cache entries and return the number removed.

Yield control to the event loop before removing entries whose timestamps are at or before now.

docstring:

docstring:

Mutate the supplied cache and counters as iteration advances, evicting oldest entries after each lookup until capacity is met. Capacity validation occurs when iteration begins.

    compute: Callable invoked with each missing key to produce its value.
    cache: Ordered cache updated in place; oldest entries are evicted first.
    max_entries: Maximum cache size after each lookup; defaults to 128.
    counters: Dictionary updated with requests, hits, misses, and evictions; None creates an internal dictionary.

    Tuples of (key, value, was_cached), with was_cached indicating whether the lookup hit the cache.

    ValueError: If max_entries is less than one.
label: correct

docstring:

    fetch: Asynchronous callable returning a value for a missing key.
